messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: service `inference-runtime` -> v4.1.0-canary at 8% (us-west & eu-central). Notes: KV cache compaction + small tokenizer fix. Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx > 1% for 3m or p95 > 420ms sustained 5m. Release notes: https://go/release/2026-03/v4.1.0
kyle: Rolling. Running canary-eval and smoke probes. @meera pls watch user-facing latency and reranking correctness.
meera: on it. excluding big-embed tenants and premium orgs. quiet-window at 21:30 UTC.
tom: 3m in: us-west p95 ~190ms, eu-central p95 ~260ms but I'm seeing a small uptick in 5xx in eu (~0.9%).
infra: looking at eu-central: tokenizer pods showing occasional OOMKills on one node pool; pod restarts correlate with error spikes. not sure if related to v4.1.0 yet.
kyle: HOLD further ramp. we should isolate region if it's unrelated. votes: GO to continue global ramp, HOLD to pause/investigate.
meera: HOLD. prefer regional isolate.
ops-bot: Recommended action: pin eu-central to previous stable `v4.0.7` while us-west continues. Command: `pin-version --service inference-runtime --region eu-central --version v4.0.7`
tom: I'll run the pin now and step traffic down in eu zones.
deploy-bot: Executing pin: inference-runtime eu-central -> v4.0.7. Staged rollback in zones to avoid cascading restarts. Audit: https://deploys/release/1717550000/pin
infra: after pin, eu-central 5xx dropped to 0.15%, restarts reduced. initial heap pressure traced to newly-scheduled node image in eu pool; not a model change.
kyle: good catch. keep canary in us-west at 8% and monitor for 20m. we'll avoid global ramp until infra confirms node image rollout complete.
meera: adding note to release log: "Partial pin in eu-central due to node-image induced tokenizer OOMs; us-west canary proceeds."
ops-bot: pin recorded. `pin-version --service inference-runtime --region eu-central --version v4.0.7` (audit id 66120).
meera: reconvene in 20m unless alerts. thanks all :coffee:
